items.name: project-name-check
items.title: Project Name Check
items.description: Vet a candidate name for a software project across package registries, domains, app stores, code hosts, and existing projects, then report which candidate is actually free. Use when picking or clearing a name for a package, library, app, CLI, extension, or repository. For a company or brand name, use business-name-check instead.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
